title: Matt Ryan: Don't know what to expect when camp starts, but feel we're in a "good spot" at QB

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt Ryan: Don't know what to expect when camp starts, but feel we're in a "good spot" at QB
sources.description: When Matt Ryan was playing for the Falcons, the team didn't have to answer any questions about their quarterback plans but his first year as the franchise's president of football isn't starting under the same circumstances.
